# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs.  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is a stout woman weighing two hundred pounds whose gait is described as a perpetual waddle. She has perceptive eyes that keep watch over passing traffic and is frequently seen sitting by her kitchen window. Her feet tire from carrying her heavy frame.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 c38 P30](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0030), [v1 c38 P31](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0031)_

## Personality

Agatha is an inquisitive, vigilant, and opinionated woman who takes pride in voicing her thoughts freely without fear or partiality. She maintains strict standards of propriety, order, and morality, often expressing dire misgivings and unsolicited warnings. Despite her meddlesome nature and tendency to nag, she possesses a kind heart, excels at homemaking, and is willing to admit when her assessments prove mistaken.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c1 P28](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0028), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby resides at Sowerby's Hollow in Brierley, where she keeps watch over the main road from her kitchen window while knitting quilts and managing her home. When the Abernethys decided to adopt a child, Agatha voiced her disapproval and misgivings. After Nell arrived, Agatha visited Grey Shutters following a bout of influenza and criticized Nell's appearance, provoking a passionate outburst from the girl. Nell later offered a dramatic apology at Agatha's home, which Agatha accepted graciously. Over the subsequent years, Agatha observed Nell's development, eventually admitting she had been wrong about her. She actively engaged in community life, directing church societies, attending political rallies in Port Marlow, and crafting a new dress for Nell at Obed's request. Following Obed Abernethy's sudden death, Agatha assisted the family, checking his pulse and spending the night at Grey Shutters to support Thirza and Nell.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P21](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0021), [v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c10 P29](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0029), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P27](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0027), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c37 P3](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0003), [v1 c37 P4](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0004), [v1 c37 P12](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0012)_
